factProposals.value: Imports directly from downloads.cms.gov/FILES/HCRIS/HOSP10FY{year}.ZIP, the official CMS HCRIS flat-file distribution, not a third-party dataset.
A single CMS HCRIS fiscal-year download bundles cost reports by when CMS processed them, not by each report's own period end date -- a report inside HOSP10FY2024.ZIP can have a fy_end_dt in 2025.

A single hospital can have more than one cost report with fiscal years that resolve to the same calendar year (e.g. an original submission and a later amended resubmission), so import logic must deterministically choose one rather than assume uniqueness.

decisions.statement: State filtering uses the CMS Certification Number's own prefix (e.g. Oklahoma = 37, 90; Texas = 45, 67, 74, 97, A9) rather than looking up the state via a separate worksheet field.
decisions.rationale: the CCN prefix is a stable, well-documented CMS convention and avoids an extra per-report worksheet lookup for a value already encoded in the identifier

decisions.statement: Every worksheet/line/column code used (cash, accounts receivable, net patient revenue, total operating expense, net income from patients, the rural/urban flag) was confirmed against a real downloaded report (RPT_REC_NUM 795252, an Oklahoma hospital) before being trusted, not taken from documentation alone.
decisions.rationale: a wrong worksheet/line reference would silently produce a plausible-looking but incorrect financial number, which this project's whole design exists to prevent

decisions.statement: DuckDB pivot results are materialized into real temp tables (CREATE TEMP TABLE), not left as lazy relations referencing a registered view name.
decisions.rationale: a lazy relation resolves a registered Python-object view name at execution time, not at query-construction time; reusing one view name ('kv') for two sequential pivots caused the first pivot to silently read the second file's data once both were finally fetched -- this returned zero results with no error, discovered only by checking a known real hospital's data by hand
decisions.evidence: pipeline/hcris_import.py#pivot (see the comment on CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE)

limitations.statement: Only fiscal year 2024 has been imported so far, not the three years the broader plan calls for.
Missing values are stored as NULL (never guessed as zero or a default), but there is no separate column recording *why* a value is missing.

The RPT flat file's 18-column layout is reconstructed from the standard documented HCRIS convention plus matching a real sample row, not from a single official field-by-field CMS specification document located during this story.
limitations.evidence: pipeline/hcris_import.py (extract_metrics, the rpt read_csv columns mapping)

demonstrationEvidence.ref: pipeline/test_hcris_import.py (12 tests: state-prefix filtering for every claimed OK/TX prefix, fiscal-year derivation from the report's own end date, deterministic dedup on genuine same-year collisions, and the invalid-format failure path)
